description: Replace a footage item's source everywhere it is used, keeping layer changes (File > Replace Footage): with another file or image sequence, a colour-bar placeholder, a solid, or a composition built from a layered Photoshop or Illustrator file (With Layered Comp)

duration.description: placeholder: seconds. Default the item's duration, or 10

file.description: file, sequence: absolute path (for a sequence, its first file)

forceAlphabetical.description: sequence: Force alphabetical order, so gaps in the numbering do not become placeholder frames. Default false

frameRate.description: placeholder: frames per second. Default the item's rate, or 30

height.description: placeholder, solid: pixels. Default the item's height

name.description: placeholder, solid: name. Default the item's name

pixelAspect.description: solid: pixel aspect ratio. Default the item's

width.description: placeholder, solid: pixels. Default the item's width

name: replace_footage
title: Replace Footage
